report.summary: Patient Marisol Tejeda (P-D002, age 46, Medicaid with a transport benefit, home tract 17031300900) screened negative for a current transportation barrier, but has a prior no-show to endocrinology (Aug 2026) and today's visit addressed uncontrolled diabetes, so transport options are being proactively offered.
